text:
Maria Chen: FYI — carrier put our FRA inbound on thermal quarantine. 8x H100s tied to PO 2319 need inspection before customs will release. looks like the hold started ~2h ago.
NexaSupply Liaison: Sorry, we see the flag. AMS->FRA manifest reclass triggered extra checks. We're pulling photos and thermal logs now.
Ashwin Patel: rough ETA on release? can we get them into EU pool this week?
NexaSupply Liaison: If customs clears after inspection today, release EOD. If not, we can offer 4x H100 air-replacement from our DE buffer tomorrow AM, fee would be expedited freight + €3k/unit.
Sven Larsson: If they send 4 as replacements, what happens to the 4 stuck units? RMA back to vendor or depot repair?
NexaSupply Liaison: Two options: 1) full RMA return-to-vendor for histogram/thermal rework (longer, ~2–3w); 2) vendor refurb via EU depot (faster, ~7–10d) — we can cover depot handling if we keep the expedited split.
Jordan (Ops): We need concrete cost split on docking/storage. FRA carrier quoted €250/day pallet storage once quarantine extends. who's absorbing that?
Emily R.: add inbound customs broker fees too — current hold added €420 so far to the bill.
Maria Chen: Logistics impact: these 8 were reserved for Dedicated EU customers (reserved pool). If 4 are replaced, we still need 2 for an incoming canary rollout next week. Can we commit replacements to specific pool tags?
Ashwin Patel: also confirm serial continuity for accounting; we can't swap model family without PO/contract sign-off.
NexaSupply Liaison: We'll ship replacements with original serials in the manifest for the 4 units we swap (we'll assign temp-serials and update ledger). We will escalate to finance to accept a credit note for the 4 delayed units if depot refurb chosen.
logistics-bot: Shipment update: FRA HOLD - Thermal inspection required. Carrier reference: AWB 123-4567890.
Maria Chen: dropping the manifest here:
```
PO: 2319-RED
AWB: 123-4567890
SKU: H100-64GB
QTY: 8
Destination: FRA Depot 14
```
NexaSupply Liaison: To avoid service outage we recommend: ship 4 air-express replacements (arrive DE-T1 tomorrow AM), vendor covers depot handling for stuck units if we accept split shipment. Otherwise vendor proposes depot refurb with 50% cost-share on storage.
Sven Larsson: What's the net ops cost to us if vendor covers depot handling? we still have to reassign 2 canary nodes to US pool — that increases cross-region egress risk/latency. Need numbers.
Ashwin Patel: Quick calc: reassigning 2 jobs -> estimated extra latency 20–40ms p95, acceptable. Cost: roughly $0.02/token for routing delta (negligible for canary). Storage fees if vendor pays depot handling: 0.
Emily R.: If vendor insists on 50% of storage, that's ~€500/week — finance will push back. Ask vendor for full coverage given misclassification trigger.
NexaSupply Liaison: We will accept full depot handling if you approve split shipment and immediate acceptance of replacements. We cannot reimburse customs broker fees (per contract) but will credit expedited freight.
Jordan (Ops): Decision request: do we accept 4 replacements + vendor covers depot handling, we reassign 2 canary nodes to US pool, and we escalate customs broker fee to procurement for review?
Maria Chen: approve that plan. Maria Chen: please confirm in writing and include AWB for replacements.
NexaSupply Liaison: Confirmed — sending 4x H100 air-express AWB 987-6543210, ETA DE-T1 06:30 UTC tomorrow. Vendor will issue credit note for expedited freight and cover depot handling for stuck units. Customs broker fee to be handled separately.
Ashwin Patel: cool. can we add a condition: vendor must provide thermal logs and depot photo evidence within 24h of release?
NexaSupply Liaison: yes — thermal logs + photos will be uploaded to the shared folder and a signed handoff doc attached.
logistics-bot: Event: replacement AWB created 987-6543210. ETA 06:30 UTC.
Maria Chen: tagging runbooks: realloc playbook + canary-move. Jordan, please coordinate the pool switch.
Jordan (Ops): on it. I'll update the rollout schedule and mark the two canary instances as EU->US failover.
Sven Larsson: thanks everyone. leaving a note for postmortem: vendor manifest classification caused delay; ensure manifest schema validation in procurement flow.
Maria Chen: noted. :thumbsup:
